meta_description: OpenDrone pre-order rounds. Explore the batches, prices and ship dates. EU and US retailers can request a bulk quote.
title: Pre-orders
timeline_eta: Ships if the target is reached
targets_line: One order ships in one parcel. Want batch 1 in {month}? Order it separately.
empty_newsletter_title: Get the next batch by email
faq_a_cancel: Any time before delivery. Full refund. [Withdrawal form](/en/herroepingsrecht#withdraw)
faq_a_missed: We email you to choose: a refund, or to wait for the new date in that email. No reply within 30 days means a refund within the following 14 days. You can also cancel before delivery.
faq_a_eta: New date by email. Cancel any time before delivery.
faq_a_shops: Consumer orders ship to the EU and the United States. Retailers can [request a bulk quote](/wholesale). Elsewhere, [get launch news](/newsletter); no consumer checkout is available.
$comment_updates: updates: "YYYY-MM-DD · text" strings, newest first. Never edit or delete an entry; add a new one.
ship_eta_if_funded: Ships by {date} if the target is reached
ship_eta_if_lead_funded: Ships by {date} if that target is reached
channel_eu_text: Orders are open for the EU and the United States. Each batch has its own timing and funding conditions. US orders ship from the batch after the EU-only paid stock.
price_steps_help: The unit price rises as each allocation sells. Your price is confirmed at checkout.
ships_with_wait: This item ships when the {lead} target is reached.
shipping_summary: Tested and inspected before it ships
terms_summary_us: Pay in full · Duties included · No sales tax
shipping_summary_us: US orders · Full refund if we cannot deliver
channel_us_text: US delivery depends on FCC equipment authorization and US import clearance. If we cannot deliver to you, you get a full refund. US orders ship from the batch after the EU-only paid stock.
us_batch_note: FC and ESC batch 1 ({month}) is EU stock only. US orders ship from the {batch} batch.
